subject: SIG initiation: MedLedger — clarifying tailored questionnaire & evidence owners
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@medledger.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: priya.shah@medledger.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery — SIG start?

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo this morning — team appreciated the low-latency examples. Our security & procurement teams are asking us to kick off the SIG/CAIQ process to keep things moving. Quick context: MedLedger is a healthcare claims orchestration startup — PHI exposure is possible in some flows, so HIPAA scope is important.

Can Redwood start a SIG prefill for us? Specific asks from procurement/security:
- Current SOC 2 status and most recent audit date
- Data residency and whether you support US-only hosting (we'll need that in a few regions)
- HIPAA BAAs and any controls specific to PHI handling
- Default retention / log retention windows and export options for audit logs

I've attached a short spreadsheet with the fields our legal team wants prefilled (MedLedger_SIG_fields_request.xlsx). We're targeting a vendor decision in ~3 weeks — can you share a proposed timeline and owners for evidence collection?

Thanks,
Sam Park
Vendor Security Manager
MedLedger

Attachment: MedLedger_SIG_fields_request.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Sam Park <sam.park@medledger.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery — SIG start?

Hi Sam — great to hear the demo landed well. Happy to get the SIG started and map owners. A couple of clarifying items before we kick off the prefill so we target the right scope: 

1) Scope: Do you want a full CAIQ (cloud security) + SIG-lite for SaaS specifics, or a custom SIG focused on HIPAA-related controls only? If PHI touches our inference pipeline, we'll include the HIPAA control mapping.
2) Residency: When you say "US-only hosting in a few regions" — which AWS regions are required (e.g., us-east-1 vs us-west-2), and is cross-region replication permitted for backups?
3) Evidence cadence: Is a one-time evidence bundle acceptable (SOC 2 report, encryption docs, network diagram) or do you need live access to logs/console for your audits?

Proposed internal owners & timeline: 
- Naomi Feldman (me) — process owner / single point of contact for document delivery and coordination
- Ben Carter — technical evidence owner (network, infra config, encryption)
- Soojin Lee — privacy & policy owner (data classification, retention, BAA)

Target timeline: 7 business days for a preliminary prefill (high-level answers + SOC 2 date + evidence pointers), 14 business days for a full prefill with attachments. If you need acceleration, we can prioritize the BAA and SOC 2 snapshot first.

Next steps:
- Sam: confirm preferred SIG form (CAIQ / SIG-lite / custom) and required regions
- Naomi: we'll upload an evidence matrix and a redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf to the Drive link and drop the prefill spreadsheet back to you within 7 business days

I attached a short evidence checklist and will CC Ben & Soojin on the follow-ups.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist.pdf (stub), redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf (stub)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Sam Park <sam.park@medledger.com>, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 14:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery — SIG start?

Hi Sam — looping in a couple of technical clarifications so we fill the right CAIQ fields: 

- PHI processing: can you confirm whether PHI will be sent to Redwood via API (at-rest or streaming) or only stored in your environment while predictions use tokens? This changes the controls we highlight (e.g., FIPS/HSM usage vs transient-in-memory processing).
- Network boundaries: if you need a VPC/private deployment, we can document Dedicated/Private deployment options but need to know expected throughput to size GPUs (hours/week).
- Logs: Our default audit log retention is 90 days; we can arrange exports for longer retention (up to 5 years) under enterprise contracts.

I'll prepare the infra evidence bundle: SOC 2 report snapshot (redacted), encryption-at-rest docs, KMS key management description, and a network diagram showing the control plane vs customer-hosted inference lanes. Naomi — I'll upload everything to the Drive link and add short README filenames that map to the spreadsheet columns.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: planned_uploads_list.txt (will be uploaded to Drive)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medledger.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@medledger.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery — SIG start?

Hi Naomi/Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. To answer your clarifying questions: 

- SIG form: Procurement wants CAIQ + a small custom section for HIPAA-specific controls (BAA confirmation, PHI handling). Please proceed with CAIQ as the base and flag the HIPAA items in the custom column.
- Regions: Primary requirement is us-east-1 and us-west-2. Cross-region replication is allowed for backups, but the active inference workloads should stay within US regions.
- PHI flow: MedLedger will send PHI to Redwood via API for a subset of workloads; data will be encrypted in transit and at rest. We expect sustained throughput on those paths approximately 40 GPU-hours/week initially.
- Evidence access: a one-time bundle is acceptable for RFP scoring — we may request live access or a short audit later.

Timeline is tight: procurement kickoff is 3 weeks from today. If you can provide the preliminary prefill in 7 business days and the full bundle in 12 business days, we'll be in good shape. 

I'll check with legal on a sample BAA template and drop it into the Drive folder once I have it.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Senior Procurement Manager
MedLedger

Attachments: (will upload BAA template if available)
